input.title: Suspected rabies outbreak near Lake Tanganyika
input.full_text: Local authorities are considering quarantine measures after a suspected outbreak of canine rabies was reported in communities near Lake Tanganyika. Vaccination teams have been requested.

input.full_text: Des inondations majeures ont frappe les bas-quartiers de Bujumbura apres des pluies torrentielles, detruisant des infrastructures et deplacant des familles.

input.title: Annual report: rural primary education
input.full_text: An annual report on rural primary education in Burundi notes a 5 percent increase in the literacy rate over the past year, attributed to expanded school programs.

input.full_text: Un reseau de trafic illegal d'especes sauvages a ete detecte aux postes frontaliers de la region des Grands Lacs. Plusieurs animaux proteges ont ete saisis.

input.full_text: Les cas confirmes de paludisme sont en forte hausse dans la province de Karuzi, avec une penurie critique de traitements antipaludiques de base signalee par les centres de sante.

input.title: Routine road repairs planned in Gitega
input.full_text: The municipality announced routine road resurfacing works scheduled for next quarter in Gitega, part of regular maintenance with no expected disruption to services.
